evidence_against.relevance: Alex behaves warmly toward several people and also makes one-on-one plans with other friends, weakening the inference that this behavior is special or romantic.
There has been no explicit romantic framing, contact, or statement of interest.
Postponing dinner twice without proposing a replacement date weakens the case for active special or romantic pursuit.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Two initiated one-on-one plans could indicate special interest, but are also consistent with friendship.
Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and bringing preferred tea show personal attentiveness.
Repeated extended conversations after group events suggest sustained interest in Jordan specifically.

recommended_action.explanation: Because the record contains meaningful signs in both directions, a direct, low-pressure clarification would be more reliable than inferring intent from ambiguous behavior.

uncertainty_explanation: Alex's personal attention and repeated one-on-one engagement support A, while Alex's generally warm behavior, lack of explicit romantic signals, and failure to reschedule support B. Neither interpretation is sufficiently better supported on these facts.
